messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m not connected to a live database, so I don’t have the most current release schedule on hand. If you let me know what region or genre you’re interested in (e.g., Hollywood blockbusters, indie films, specific streaming platforms), I can give you a general idea of what’s been coming out recently.
message.reasoning: User asks "What are the latest movie releases?" They want info about movies. We can provide a list of recent releases. But we don't have real-time data. We could say we don't have up-to-date info. Or we can ask clarifying question. Probably best to respond with a disclaimer and ask for more specifics.
